verdict.rationale: Zero is an email client, so assigning conversations and routing mail with rules is a fair question for it. The evidence covers only label management, search, compose and AI chat, with no assignment to teammates and no rule-based routing. AI auto-categorization and label editing are adjacent features, not ownership assignment or routing rules.

support.subject: As a team-lead, I can assign conversations to teammates and route incoming mail with rules so ownership is explicit
